notes.title: Next update sneak peek
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you enjoy your weekend :)

GCH 3.8 is under way! Lots of work has been poured in this update. We are pleased to show you this small snapshot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26633391/96d18de37a07f0fdb51fffd412cceecfcc3ea22e.png[/img]

[i]Beware, you will only be able to import RPG Maker MV DLCs that are installed on your machine.[/i]

[h3]When will it be released?[/h3]

This update is a cooperative effort with people from Degica. Some RPG Maker MV DLCs files need to be fixed before the release of GCH 3.8. You need to wait at most a few more weeks.

[h3]Will GCH:PE support RPG Maker MZ?[/h3]

Support for RPG Maker MZ is still under discussion with Degica and Enterbrain. There is no doubt it will be supported at some point :) We are doing our best to speed things up.

[h3]Other news[/h3]

We are also pleased to announce that GCH has a [url=https://www.gamecharacterhub.com]brand-new website[/url], along with a [url=https://twitter.com/GameCharHub]new twitter channel[/url] (better late than never right?) We will post more regular updates on twitter so don't forget to follow us if you don't want to miss out!

That's all folks!

notes.title: Game Character Hub :PE - VX Ace item fix and upcoming update news
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We just released a small update for the Portfolio Edition. This update aims to fix RPG Maker VX Ace items. We added some files that were missing: 40 outfits and 6 glasses items. We also moved the naked body part to a location that is more natural (inside the Body/(Fe)male folders). We want to thank you for your support and your feedback on this!

Also, a few words about the next major update: It will bring Workshop support. Unfortunately Valve does not allow to import all GCH's workshop files into the upcoming GCH:PE's workshop. GCH's workshop is getting bigger every day, and offers many top quality items thanks to you, and that's something we value ;) We don't want to lose this in GCH:PE so we are actively working on solutions to easily port the base GCH workshop files into GCH:PE's future workshop.

We hope you will enjoy :)

notes.title: Game Character Hub Demo Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are glad to announce that we have put together a Trial version of the Portfolio Edition :) This version is provided for free and allows you to test Game Character Hub. It is not time-limited so feel free to take all the time you need to fully test it! The only limitation is that you cannot export your work to PNG files. This means that you cannot use your work outside Game Character Hub unless you purchase the full version.

We hope you will enjoy it and be convinced by GCH's powerful character creation features :)

And last but not least, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year :) !

notes.title: Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition - RPG Maker DS/DS+ & Second Story DLC release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce the release of Second Story and RPG Maker DS/DS+ generator parts! Both were already available on the previous version of GCH, and now have been ported to the Portfolio Edition as well. A few words about each of them:

[b]Second Story[/b]:
[i]It's the first character asset pack created with no engine limitation. With this add-on, you can generate stylish pixel characters for use in any 2D game-creation software. Formatted and optimized for use with Game Character Hub, Second Story is both versatile and practical.[/i]

[b]RPG Maker DS/DS+ generator parts[/b]:
[i]Invoking the feel of SNES-era RPGs, this pack contain more than 150 new unique items to be used with RPG Maker VX Ace engine. We hope you will enjoy these new character parts in retro style :)[/i]

Both packs have been tailored to adapt to the Portfolio Edition advanced layer system: when generator parts are added to your document, their layers will be automatically inserted at the right position so that no superposition issues occur :)

As promised, these packs are provided for free if you already owned them in the previous version of GCH. We hope you will enjoy :)

notes.title: GCH:PE Statement/Update
notes.notes:
Hi there,
There has been a lot of discussion over the weekend about Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition.

The developer Sebastien Bini has just created a thread addressing some of the concerns and detailing what is in the new version:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/529830/discussions/0/312265782623798262/

Essentially, Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition is a complete new product, and not just an upgrade to the original Game Character Hub. It's been rebuilt from the ground up to support RPG Maker MV and has a lot of improvements and tweaks. 

The developer is also committed to updating it for free for at least the next 2 years. Just like he did with Game Character Hub, he'll take feature requests from users and implement them.

We realize that some users may be upset as the MV update was originally going to be released last winter as part of Game Character Hub.
We apologize for the lack of communication on our part and any confusion it may have caused.

Here's how we're going to fix this:

1. Loyalty Discount
We are looking into setting up a 50% loyalty discount for any GCH owners who purchase GCH:PE. Any GCH owner that has already purchased GCH:PE will receive equivalent RPG maker store credit or a DLC pack. We will have more details on this shortly.

2. Free Trial Version
We'll be releasing a free trial version of Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition in the next 1-2 weeks. It will be a fully featured 15 day trial so you will be able to see for yourself what the new Game Character Hub is like.

3. Future Updates
Sebastien plans on continuing to update Game Character Hub: Portfolio Edition. He's focusing on Steam Workshop support as well as improvements to the drawing tools. He's also welcoming user feedback and suggestions for improvements.

We really appreciate the support everyone has shown for Game Character Hub over the past few years. We hope you'll forgive us this honest mistake and join us in Portfolio Edition.

cheers,

The Game Character Hub Team
